tools.name: search_apps
tools.description: Find apps in the archive by name or developer. Returns store, id and best saved rank.

tools.name: get_chart
tools.description: A saved App Store or Google Play top chart for a country and day, from 2026-11-06.

tools.name: get_app_rank_history
tools.description: Every saved chart an app has been on, with its daily ranks. Get the id from search_apps.

tools.name: get_trending_searches
tools.description: Top Google trending searches in a country on a past day, from 2024-11-28. Some days are missing.

tools.name: get_top_trends
tools.description: Biggest Google trending searches in a country for a month (YYYY-MM) or year (YYYY).

tools.name: get_world_trends
tools.description: Searches that trended in the most countries on a day (YYYY-MM-DD) or in a year (YYYY).

tools.name: list_scrapers
tools.description: All Wulfcare scrapers on Apify for live data: Google Trends, YouTube, app stores, jobs, hotels, flights and AI search.
